instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL_DEPENDENCIES: yarn add lucide-react sonner clsx tailwind-merge date-fns react-day-picker
THEME_SETUP: Ensure dark mode toggle works using a ThemeProvider context.
COMPONENT_OVERRIDE: Do not use default Shadcn 'zinc' colors. Override tailwind.config.js with the provided Brand Colors.
MOBILE_FIRST: Always test layouts at 'grid-cols-1' first before adding 'md:grid-cols-3'.
NAVIGATION: Use a sticky bottom nav for mobile (Cleaner/Rider view) and Sidebar for desktop (Manager view).
FORMS: Use Shadcn Form + React Hook Form + Zod for all inputs.
ICAL_ICONS: Use specific colors for Airbnb (red) and Booking.com (blue) when displaying calendar sources.
DATA_TESTID: Add data-testid='...' to all interactive elements for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid 'AI Slop': Do not use generic gradients or centered text layouts.
Create depth: Use z-index and subtle shadows to layer content.
Micro-animations: Add hover states and transitions to everything interactive.
Spacing: Use 'p-6' or 'p-8' inside cards to let content breathe.
No generic AI emojis: Do not use 🚀, 💡, ⚡️ in UI.
Contrast: Ensure text is readable on the #F24E75 primary color (use white text).
